verdict.rationale: GitCafe does not document its own natural-language command interface. It does run a first-party MCP server at git.cafe/mcp, so AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT can read repositories and, with your approval, work on issues and pull requests. It also exposes those MCP tools to browser agents via WebMCP and offers agent skills, so natural-language operation works only through external AI clients. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command surface, evidence of which operations beyond issues and PRs the MCP tools cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
